name: popover
source: ui/components/Popover/Popover.vue (kit; wraps Ant a-popover). Related primitive: src/components/_base-popper.vue (MPopper, wraps v-popover).
summary: Click-triggered floating panel anchored to a trigger, holding interactive content (action menus, pickers, mini-forms). Slots trigger/title/default each get {hide,show,toggle}. MPopper is the lower-level v-popover positioning primitive that powers FlotoDropdownPicker.

slots.trigger: the anchor; scope { hide, show, toggle }
slots.title: optional header; scope { hide, show, toggle }
slots.default: the panel content; scope { hide, show, toggle }

decisionFlow: Is the content a short non-interactive hint? -> Tooltip, not Popover.
Is it a row/item action list (edit/duplicate/delete)? -> Popover action menu (placement='bottomRight').
Is it a picker/mini-form/color or date picker? -> Popover rich panel (often a custom overlay-class).
Is it a center-interrupting task or confirmation? -> Modal, not Popover.
Is it a select-from-options field? -> FlotoDropdownPicker (which uses MPopper internally).

actionMenu.how: kebab (ellipsis-v) trigger, placement='bottomRight', items call hide()

hoverReveal.useWhen: a passive reveal on hover (no click) — +N overflow, quick peek

click.useWhen: The anchored content is interactive and should open on an explicit click — a menu, picker, or mini-form the user deliberately opens. This is the default trigger (20× in the product) and the right choice for anything requiring interaction rather than a passive peek.
click.dontUse: Don't use click for a passive '+N overflow' or quick-info peek that should reveal on hover (use trigger=hover); don't use it for a short non-interactive hint (use MTooltip); and don't use it for a center-interrupting task or confirmation (use MModal).
click.example: The color picker (color-picker.vue) and date/time pickers open their panel on a click trigger; FlotoGridActions kebab menus also click-open.

hover.useWhen: You want a passive reveal with no click — the '+N overflow' pill that shows hidden items, or a quick info peek. Common in the product (13×), usually paired with transition-name='slide-up'.
hover.dontUse: Don't use hover for menus or pickers that need deliberate interaction (use trigger=click); don't use it for a plain text hint (use MTooltip); don't use it when content must stay open while the user works inside it.
hover.example: The '+N' overflow reveal in tags-list.vue and interface-template.vue that surfaces the hidden tags/items on hover (13× of popovers use hover).

action-menu.useWhen: You need a kebab (ellipsis-v) menu of item actions opening a dark picker-action-dropdown panel, placement='bottomRight', transition-name='slide-up', each item calling hide() on select. This is the shared FlotoGridActions engine (_base-grid-actions.vue, 89×) — use for widget-header chrome (Full Screen · Share · Export as CSV) or the multi-select bulk-action bar's 'More' overflow.
action-menu.dontUse: Don't use it for a single table row's actions when you specifically need the Edit·Clone·Disable·Delete(red) set below a divider — that's the grid-row-actions variant; don't use it for a picker or mini-form (use rich-panel); don't hand-roll a select dropdown (use FlotoDropdownPicker).
action-menu.example: The widget-header kebab (widget-title.vue) with Full Screen · Share · Export as CSV, and the bulk-action bar 'More' overflow kebab (_base-bulk-action-bar.vue) that opens upward (topRight) with overlay-class bulk-action-bar-more.

grid-row-actions.useWhen: A table ROW needs its per-row actions — Edit · Clone · Disable · divider · Delete(red). The 89× default of FlotoGridActions: ellipsis-v trigger, placement='bottomRight', a divider plus a danger item (isDanger -> text-secondary-red), each item calling hide().
grid-row-actions.dontUse: Don't use it for widget chrome or multi-select toolbars (use the action-menu variants — widget-header kebab / bulk-action bar); don't use it for a picker/mini-form (use rich-panel); don't use it for a passive hover reveal (use hover).
grid-row-actions.example: The grid row kebab across list tables — Edit · Clone · Disable · — · Delete (red, below a divider) — the 89× default rendered by _base-grid-actions.vue.

rich-panel.useWhen: An interactive picker or small mini-form should float by its trigger. Use trigger='click' plus a custom overlay-class-name to style the floating panel.
rich-panel.dontUse: Don't use it for a list of item actions (use action-menu / grid-row-actions); don't use it for a plain hint (use MTooltip); don't use it for a select-from-options field (use FlotoDropdownPicker, which uses MPopper internally); don't use it for a center-interrupting task (use MModal).
rich-panel.example: The color picker (color-picker.vue) with overlay-class color-picker-popover, and the date/time picker panels (picker-overlay / picker-action-dropdown overlay classes).

placementVocabulary: Ant names (bottomLeft/bottomRight/leftTop/bottom/top) — NOT the Tooltip's VTippy names (top-start). Not interchangeable.
do: Give items a hide() on select
dont: Don't use for plain hints (use Tooltip)
Don't use for center-interrupting tasks/confirmations (use Modal)
Don't hand-roll a select dropdown (use FlotoDropdownPicker)

F1.issue: `visible` is one-way — controlled mode needs an explicit @visibleChange handler to stay in sync.

F2.issue: Trigger lacks aria-haspopup/aria-expanded; no focus move into the panel on open and no focus-trap — keyboard/SR users aren't told a panel opened.

F3.issue: No focus ring (`:focus { outline:none }` in _base-popper) — links to SF-001.

a11y.summary: Holds interactive content → focus handling matters. Outside-click / Esc close (from a-popover); verify Esc returns focus.
issues: Trigger not announced as a disclosure — no aria-haspopup/expanded (F2).
Focus not moved into the panel; no focus trap.
a11y.$note: Catalogue-wide gap SF-001 = no visible :focus-visible ring; tracked in findings/.
